responsibility: Main Objective-C semantic action and front-end implementation file. It owns parsing-side construction and validation of Objective-C tree nodes for classes, categories, protocols, methods, ivars, properties, message expressions, exceptions, and fast enumeration; maintains global lookup tables for methods and class names; performs diagnostics and name/type checking; gimplifies Objective-C-specific expressions such as PROPERTY_REF and message sends; and coordinates runtime-specific lowering by calling the selected objc_runtime_hooks and shared metadata helpers.
same_name_distinction: Source implementation for the objc-act semantic layer: it defines the front end behavior declared in objc-act.h, including semantic actions, tree construction/checking, gimplification, and runtime-hook coordination. Unlike the header, it contains the executable logic and private state such as method/class maps.
